explanation: The Almighty Creator who is everywhere and sees all, specifically mentioned here as the righteous judge who does not despise the oppressed.
An attitude where a wife voluntarily places herself in a position of respectful obedience toward her husband, as was common in ancient society.
The true and eternal beauty found in a gentle and quiet spirit, which God regards as more powerful than outward adornment or hairstyle.
A state of being chosen and set apart for God's purpose, living according to His will rather than the world's standards.
Enduring pain or injustice without taking revenge, especially when it occurs because of a good conscience or faith in Christ.
The death and resurrection of Jesus who took our sins upon Himself so that we might be justified in God's sight.
The symbol of the flood during Noah's time, which also represents baptism as a cleansing of the soul through faith in Jesus' resurrection.
A ritual in which one is washed with water as a pledge to God, something that does not remove dirt from the body but is an appeal to God for a good conscience.
